audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for silver cup test, pursuit, Benjamin's sack, brothers' return, Judah's intercession, surety, and substitution offer.

verses.restored: Joseph commanded the one over his house, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s silver in the mouth of his sack.

familiar.text: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

verses.restored: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack, along with his grain silver. He did according to Joseph’s word.

familiar.text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

verses.restored: At morning light the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

familiar.text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

verses.restored: They had gone out of the city, not far, when Joseph said to the one over his house, Rise, pursue the men, overtake them, and say, Why have you repaid evil for good?

familiar.text: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

verses.restored: Is this not the cup from which my lord drinks and by which he surely divines? You have done evil in what you have done.

familiar.text: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

verses.restored: He overtook them and spoke these words to them.

familiar.text: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

verses.restored: They said to him, Why does my lord speak such words? Far be it from your servants to do such a thing.

familiar.text: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

verses.restored: Look, the silver we found in the mouth of our sacks we brought back to you from Canaan. How then would we steal silver or gold from your lord’s house?

familiar.text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?

verses.restored: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will become servants to my lord.

familiar.text: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.

verses.restored: He said, Now also let it be according to your words: the one with whom it is found shall be my servant, but you shall be innocent.

familiar.text: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

verses.restored: They quickly lowered each man’s sack to the ground, and each opened his sack.

familiar.text: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

verses.restored: He searched, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest, and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

familiar.text: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

verses.restored: They tore their garments, loaded each man his donkey, and returned to the city.

familiar.text: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

verses.restored: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there; they fell before him to the ground.

familiar.text: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

verses.restored: Joseph said to them, What deed is this that you have done? Did you not know that a man like me surely divines?

familiar.text: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

verses.restored: Judah said, What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak, and how shall we justify ourselves? The Divine has found out the guilt of your servants. Look, we are servants to my lord, both we and the one in whose hand the cup was found.

familiar.text: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

verses.restored: He said, Far be it from me to do this. The man in whose hand the cup was found shall be my servant, but you go up in peace to your father.

familiar.text: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

verses.restored: Judah came near to him and said, Please, my lord, let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and do not let your anger burn against your servant, for you are like Pharaoh.

familiar.text: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

verses.restored: My lord asked his servants, saying, Do you have a father or a brother?

familiar.text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

verses.restored: We said to my lord, We have an aged father and a young child of his old age. His brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him.

familiar.text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

verses.restored: You said to your servants, Bring him down to me, so I may set my eyes on him.

familiar.text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

verses.restored: We said to my lord, The boy cannot leave his father; if he leaves his father, his father will die.

familiar.text: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

verses.restored: You said to your servants, Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall not see my face again.

familiar.text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

verses.restored: When we went up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

familiar.text: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

verses.restored: Our father said, Return, buy us a little food.

familiar.text: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

verses.restored: We said, We cannot go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down; for we cannot see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.

familiar.text: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.

verses.restored: Your servant my father said to us, You know that my woman bore me two sons.

familiar.text: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

verses.restored: One went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn apart, and I have not seen him until now.

familiar.text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

verses.restored: If you take this one also from before my face and harm meets him, you will bring down my gray hair in evil to Sheol.

familiar.text: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.restored: Now, when I come to your servant my father and the boy is not with us, since his soul is bound to his soul,

familiar.text: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;

verses.restored: when he sees that the boy is not there, he will die; and your servants will bring down the gray hair of your servant our father in sorrow to Sheol.

familiar.text: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

verses.restored: For your servant became surety for the boy to my father, saying, If I do not bring him to you, I will bear the blame before my father all the days.

familiar.text: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

verses.restored: Now please let your servant remain instead of the boy as a servant to my lord, and let the boy go up with his brothers.

familiar.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

verses.restored: For how can I go up to my father if the boy is not with me? I cannot see the evil that would find my father.

familiar.text: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
